purpose: Inventory and production plan for required character/page/theme slots. The missing matrix remains open. This is not a runtime selector, test suite, quality score or completed visual matrix.

statusDefinitions.approved: A specific version/use has actual relevant static/layout/motion/adoption receipts. Never inferred from a filename or prior static flag.
statusDefinitions.shared-compatible: A particular reuse has explicit verified identity, support, light and layout compatibility for its scope.
statusDefinitions.static-fallback: A selected static/limited mechanism keeps the route usable while required normal performance remains incomplete; not dynamic completion.
statusDefinitions.not-applicable: A genuine semantic reason means the action is unnecessary; absent assets/tools are not such a reason.
statusDefinitions.missing: A required resource, action, qualified context or relevant evidence has no accepted equivalent.

evidenceRules: Prior registration approval, exact hash admission, present image inspection, live layout and continuous normal motion are separate.
The inventory creates no current-view or runtime-acceptance receipt.
The artwork allowlist contains only current target manifest files whose exact bytes match that manifest.
Automatic unknown-weather time-only sources keep canonical light/palette/support and do not count as every requested theme/activity.
Portraits, edge cats, repeated props, mirrors and static fallback do not finish the human motion matrix.
Spring/summer/winter remain missing seasonal directions; an autumn-biased existing illustration is not a sensor reading.
Character mood is art direction and preserves independent judgment, not a classification of the user.
No required normal action is marked not-applicable because the necessary asset is missing.
